title: [A2 • Band 4.0] Bài 103: Tyrian Purple: The Royal Dye of the Ancient Mediterranean
passageHtml:
READING PASSAGE — A2 (BAND 4.0) • TEST 103

Tyrian Purple: The Royal Dye of the Ancient Mediterranean

Paragraph 1. In ancient times, rich people loved purple clothes. The most famous purple dye was called Tyrian purple. The Phoenician people made it in the city of Tyre, which is in modern Lebanon. Kings and leaders wore purple coats to show their power. Other plant dyes lost their colour quickly when people washed them or put them in the sun. However, Tyrian purple was special. Sunlight and fresh air actually made its colour brighter and stronger.

Paragraph 2. This famous dye did not come from a plant. It came from a small sea snail that eats other sea animals. Making the dye was slow and very smelly work. Fishermen caught millions of snails using baskets with dead fish inside. Next, workers took a clear liquid from inside each snail. They put this liquid into big salt water tanks for three days. Then they boiled it in large metal pots over a gentle fire for ten days.

Paragraph 3. The boiling snails produced a terrible smell. People could smell the dye workshops from kilometres away. Roman city leaders made a strict rule: workers had to build dye factories far outside towns. After ten days of boiling, workers put white wool into the warm liquid. When they dried the cloth outside, direct sunlight changed the clear liquid into bright green, yellow, red, and finally dark purple.

Paragraph 4. Tyrian purple was extremely expensive because each snail gave only a tiny drop of liquid. Ancient writer Pliny said it took about 10,000 snails to make just one gram of pure dye. As a result, purple cloth cost even more than gold. In Rome, only the Emperor could wear a full purple coat, and ordinary people faced heavy punishment if they broke this law.

groups.title: Questions 5–7
groups.instructions:
Do the following statements agree with the information given in the passage?
Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

steps: Đoạn 2: "It came from a small sea snail..." → Từ cần điền là snail.
Đoạn 2: "Fishermen caught millions of snails using baskets with dead fish inside." → Từ cần điền là baskets.
Đoạn 2: "They put this liquid into big salt water tanks for three days." → Từ cần điền là salt.
Đoạn 3: "workers put white wool into the warm liquid." → Từ cần điền là wool.

q5.text: Roman city leaders allowed dye factories inside busy towns.

steps: Đoạn 3: Luật La Mã bắt buộc xây xưởng nhuộm "far outside towns" (xa ngoài thành phố), trái ngược với "inside busy towns" → Chọn FALSE.

q6.text: Around 10,000 sea animals were needed to make one gram of pure dye.

steps: Đoạn 4: "it took about 10,000 snails to make just one gram of pure dye." → Khớp hoàn toàn, chọn TRUE.

q7.text: Pliny the Elder became wealthy by selling purple coats in Rome.

steps: Đoạn 4: Bài chỉ nói nhà văn Pliny ghi lại số lượng ốc và chỉ Hoàng đế được mặc áo tím, hoàn toàn không nói Pliny có bán áo tím hay trở nên giàu có không → Chọn NOT GIVEN.
